note: Both sets are nearly identical in content, containing the same correct extractions (member sizes, keynotes) and the same errors (misbound conditions like 'TYP' applied to beams/channels instead of plates, misbound dimensions like '1'-4"' applied to C3X6 length). Both suffer from significant duplication (e.g., extracting L-angle and Angle (L) separately, multiple claims for C3X6 section) and vague entities ('component'). Set B uses slightly more specific entity names ('structural member' vs 'member' for one W8X10 claim), but this does not materially improve the set.
